title: The fed-write guard reads any folder root from disk, not only the current folder
why: Forms such as `grep -rl … hooks | xargs sed -i` pass, because the guard reads only `.` as a root.
note: Coordinator pick, 18:14 CST Nov 7, can be undone. Starts when #1658 (fed-write-followups-2, round 2 passed at 244e87062) is handed to runner 8, stacked on it.
